background: Westpac is Australia's oldest bank and one of the big four, funded by Australian and New Zealand deposits and wholesale markets and lending mainly on residential mortgages and to businesses, with a New Zealand subsidiary.
synthesis: Rated AA- on average across all three, all on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 26 May 2024. Capital is strong against Australian banks, with CET1 of 12.5% and leverage of 5.0% in the top quarter, and LCR of 137% is too, though NSFR of 113% is in the bottom quarter. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods to 30 Sep 2026.
